method: Actual current main/preload/production renderer with protected acceptance session on the user-authorized Jellyfin server. One uniquely named private temporary playlist contains two copies of one song and two unique songs. Native UI controls perform playback, selection, reorder and removal; independent authenticated reads verify persisted changes.
contractInterpretation: P04 covers authorized edits to safely identified entries and playlist/selected playback order. The unchanged PRD explicitly restricts Move/Remove for ambiguous handles; P19 separately verifies that restriction. P04 does not require guessing an ambiguous occurrence or whole-list replacement.
privacy: Fresh isolated app data copies only the existing encrypted connection and device identity.
All non-acceptance origins are blocked; shared provider adapters return no keys and fresh local state contains no radio setup.
Mutation guard permits one exact temporary playlist name and item mutations only under its returned ID.
Cleanup independently checks exact name and Playlist type before deletion and confirms a404 afterward.
No existing playlist is edited. Credentials, raw track IDs and playlist IDs are omitted from this record.
limits: One live Jellyfin server/runtime; no claim covers arbitrary server versions or cross-client transactions.
Native audio is muted; advancing audio establishes decoding and order, not audible quality or observed usability.
Ambiguous occurrence-specific editing remains unavailable by design when Jellyfin cannot identify that position.
P01 accessible-list coverage and P05 real read-only/unavailable permission configurations remain Review.
No smaller-window or enlarged-zoom checks were run.
